title: Starter Bags Bought before a Tailwise Autoship Prescription Diet Subscription
content:
**Tailwise Pharmacy note — starter bags of a prescription diet**

A starter bag already bought takes days off the diet days of a new prescription diet Autoship (an Autoship Pharmacy subscription under Tailwise Autoship for the pet's Rx Prescription Diet prescription). The fills are read from the Tailwise Pharmacy fill records of the diet prescription: fills dispensed through the one-time-order channel.

1. When the latest one-time-order fill of the diet prescription was dispensed no more than 30 days ago, 4 days come off.
2. When the latest such fill was dispensed more than 30 but no more than 90 days ago, 2 days come off.
3. Otherwise — no such fill, or the latest one more than 90 days ago — no days come off.

Only the latest one-time-order fill decides; its age is the calendar days from the date it was dispensed to the day the value is worked out.

| Latest one-time-order fill of the diet prescription | Days off |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 days ago | 4 |
| 31 to 90 days ago | 2 |
| more than 90 days ago, or none | none |

**Hypothetical record.** One fill 100 days ago and another 25 days ago: the latest is 25 days old, 4 days come off.
